entries.stylePrompt: Render the supplied subject as a subdued hand-drawn 2D animation illustration with naturally proportioned adult figures and a quiet everyday atmosphere. Give adults a modest head size relative to the shoulders and torso, a natural length of midface, a clearly drawn nose bridge and tip, a small understated mouth, and gently angular jaw contours. Draw eyes as small to medium almond shapes with modest irises, fine upper lids, simple eyebrows and tiny ordinary catchlights; avoid enormous eyes, decorative lashes, baby-like proportions or symbolic dot faces. Preserve the adult age and supplied expression. Use thin consistent dark charcoal or local-color contours with a few slight line-weight changes at overlaps, never thick comic outlines. Organize hair into broad solid cel shapes with a small number of fine directional separation lines, rather than individually painted strands. Apply calm mostly flat local colors and one restrained hard-edged, slightly cool shadow step on each important form; keep skin largely flat with a small neck or side-plane shadow, no sculptural portrait modeling. Clothes retain natural shoulder, sleeve and elbow construction with a few economical fold lines and clean muted shadow shapes. Draw hands with plausible adult anatomy and clearly grouped fingers, without exaggerated mitten simplification or hyperrealistic detail. Preserve supplied local colors while keeping saturation moderate and avoiding glossy highlights. Background architecture should feel observed and lived-in: clear everyday perspective, warm gray and cream materials, muted slate and teal accents, selected small structural details and broad quiet painted planes. Keep the background slightly softer in line contrast than the character but legible, without photographic texture, dramatic action staging or cinematic glow. Avoid polished light-novel beauty rendering, ornate fantasy costuming, exaggerated manga facial construction, soft all-over airbrush shading, photorealistic skin, flat icon-like deformation and decorative poster collage. Follow the separate subject-and-scene instruction for people, clothing, objects and setting; do not introduce unrelated rooms, books, animals, costumes or props. Render one coherent scene with no panel divisions, typography, logos, borders or watermarks.
entries.scenePrompt: Create one wide 16:9 landscape image, with no border or typography. A young adult East Asian man with tousled dark brown hair and brown eyes wears a mustard-yellow hooded raincoat over a white knit sweater and a black backpack. He holds a small bouquet of sunflowers in both hands at chest level, with the entire bouquet visible near the lower edge. Frame him from the waist up in a medium close-up, slightly left of center: his head, torso, and bouquet should fill most of the left half of the image. His body is turned three-quarters to the right, and he looks toward the right with a quiet, thoughtful expression. He stands at a glass-sided seaside bus stop at dawn. The shelter roof and glass supports recede diagonally from the upper left, with a simple bench behind him. The sea remains clearly visible across the right half of the background beyond a low coastal railing; a small distant lighthouse stands near the far-right horizon. A low dawn sun and a cloudy sky appear above the sea. Keep the man, bouquet, bus stop, and sea all clearly visible.
